description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Creates a new brand in the account owner's organization, the same as "New brand" in the dashboard. Send `name` and optionally `website`, like `{ name: "Dragon Shop", website: "https://shop.example.com" }`. Only an ACCOUNT-WIDE connection with the write scope can do this; a connection bound to one brand gets 403. The plan's brand limit applies: at the limit the call is a 402 and nothing is created (relay the message). Optional `profile`, `voice`, `colors` and `fonts` (the brand_profile_update shapes) and `logoStorageId` (an image from upload_media) are saved in the same call. Full description and schema: describe_tool {"name":"create_brand"}.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/brands.)

colors.description: Format: object; e.g. {"primary":"#112233"}. Fields: primary, secondary, palette.

fonts.description: Format: object; e.g. {"heading":"Inter"}. Font family names. A role left out keeps its stored font. At least one is required. Fields: heading, body.

logoStorageId.description: Format: string; e.g. "logoStorageId_123". A storageId from POST /api/v2/media/upload-url (an image). It becomes the brand's primary logo.

name.description: Format: string; e.g. "Summer launch". The brand name. Must not match another active brand in the organization.

orgId.description: Format: string; e.g. "orgId_123". The organization to create in.

profile.description: Format: object; e.g. {"companyName":"Example Studio"}. Only the fields sent are changed. Fields: companyName, tagline, mission, industry, website, competitors, ….

voice.description: Format: object; e.g. {"name":"Summer launch"}. The brand default voice. Created (as the default) when the brand has none. Fields: name, tone, style, targetAudience, keywords, avoidWords, ….

website.description: Format: string; e.g. "https://example.com". The brand's website. Shortcut for profile.website.

name: create_brand
title: Create a brand
